name: media_lookup
description: Look up an online video or playlist without downloading it. Returns the title, channel, duration, publish date, views, available video qualities, subtitle and automatic-caption languages, chapters, tags and description; for playlists, the list of videos with their URLs. Use it before downloading to check what is available, or to answer questions about a video.

url.description: Address of the video or playlist page (http or https).

playlist_limit.description: For playlists: how many entries to list. Default 25.

max_description.description: Maximum characters of the description to include (0 = omit). Default 1500.
